publisher: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Waterworks
title: Calculation method (23 wards), FAQ, and basic-charge waiver guidance — partial capture
archive_note: PARTIAL. A direct fetch was refused by the site's bot protection; the passages are the Bureau's own text as returned in search-engine extracts of its pages. An extract of an extract is weaker than a direct capture, and it is why Tokyo stays unpriced.
establishes: The billing formula and its rounding rule: (basic + volumetric) x 1.10, truncated to the yen, stated by the Bureau for both water and sewerage
The basic charge of 1,170 yen a month and the 10% consumption tax rate, from the Bureau's own bi-monthly worked example totalling 9,038 yen
That 5 m3 a month is a basic volume included in the basic charge for connections of 25 mm or below, not an ordinary zero-rated tier
That the waiver covers the basic charge only: the volumetric charge and sewerage are billed as normal
That billing is bi-monthly and the rate table has applied since the December 2019 billing month
does_not_establish: The tier table itself, which is the thing being corroborated. Reproducing three of the Bureau's published totals constrains the tiers tightly and is not the same as reading them.
The waiver instrument. Under §5.4 the payable/structural split turns entirely on it, so it must be the original rather than a guidance page in extract.
reconciliations_passed: 20 mm at 24 m3 a month: 3,533 yen, 147.2 yen per m3 — the Bureau says about 147.2. Exact.
The Bureau's bi-monthly worked example: 9,038.7 truncated to 9,038. Exact.
The waiver value for a 20 mm connection over four months: 1,170 x 1.10 x 4 = 5,148. Exact.
